announcement_191.instructions: Evaluate only posts[9]. Does the text announce or remind readers of a specific scheduled gathering, such as a concert, party, lecture or meetup? Product advertising, event reviews, general schedules and vague plans do not count.

date_191.instructions: Evaluate only posts[9]. Does the text state a calendar date or relative day for that gathering, such as tomorrow or next Saturday? Do not infer a date.

time_191.instructions: Evaluate only posts[9]. Does the text state a clock time or time range for that gathering? Do not infer a time.

invitation_191.instructions: Evaluate only posts[9]. Does the text invite readers to attend the gathering or ask them to take action to attend it?

tickets_191.instructions: Evaluate only posts[9]. Does the text mention admission tickets or a price for attending the gathering?

registration_191.instructions: Evaluate only posts[9]. Does the text mention registering, reserving or booking a place at the gathering?

digest_191.instructions: Evaluate only posts[9]. Is this post primarily a roundup of several independent events, each with its own title, date or destination, rather than an announcement of one event? A multi-day festival or the program of one gathering is not a roundup.

focused_191.instructions: Evaluate only posts[9]. Is the main purpose of this post to invite readers to one specific future event? An article, recap, general course promotion or list of upcoming events does not count, even when it mentions dates.
